label: Selected-world concreteness and productive countercases
summary:
35871d99-a2e5-5625-82c4-2b61836633a2 (Variant): 5ed36963 projects the owner-approved weak commitment from the strong all-causal-senses hypothesis. The weak formula already suffices for its consumers that require causal power and efficient causes only; the strength result provides no evidence for the all-senses addition. Retain the strong statement solely as the stronger comparison input.

488eb991-a56a-506e-bc04-dd0abf33b80f (Bridge): 210f93d4 and 25ce9863 need three separate no-esse productive exclusions of set, Form and mathematical-object cases in the same profile. Exclusion of the supplied equality cases against a GOD_4 candidate does not rule out productive power assigned elsewhere in the frame. For each named case, test whether its claimed role is productive esse-giving or structural/explanatory contribution, retaining the selected-world bearer.

d75fefb5-07e7-590b-bba9-693dabd9da9d (Bridge): The same consumers require that existence of a capacity-only or productive no-esse countercase entail existence of some named productive one. It need not be the original witness. The capacity-only case illustrates the missing step from a power-having profile to any named producer; narrowing productive coverage alone still leaves that case. Test capacity-only and further-category productive cases separately on the same frame, or use independently justified restricted coverage that gives the exact intended weak conclusion.
blocker: A capacity-only no-esse case and a further productive category remain distinct application gaps for the named elimination route.
